title: Hub and spoke
content: Hub and spoke is a site structure in which a hub page covers a broad topic and links to spoke pages on its subtopics, each of which links back to the hub.

meta.why: Google uses links to find pages and to judge their relevance, and a hub with spokes gives a reader and a crawler a path from the broad topic to the detail and back.
meta.example: A glossary page lists its terms and links to a separate page for each one, and each term page links back to the glossary.
meta.check: Confirm the hub links to each spoke with descriptive link text and each spoke links back to the hub.
meta.limitation: The structure organizes pages and does not make a thin spoke page useful.
